name: Voice
author: azzen
description: Voice control for Omarchy with spoken replies. Push-to-talk (Super+Ctrl+Space) or bar mic button; speech is transcribed by Voxtype and matched against a local rule set to run Omarchy/system/app/plugin actions, and Omarchy talks back via Piper TTS.

barWidget.description: Bar mic button to control Omarchy by voice and hear spoken replies.
